primary_sources.not_used_for: a complete numerical basis realization, Gaunt coefficients, ADM constraints, or a physical prediction
primary_sources.source: L. Lindblom, N. W. Taylor and F. Zhang, Scalar, Vector and Tensor Harmonics on the Three-Sphere, Gen. Rel. Grav. 49 (2017) 139, arXiv:1709.08020
primary_sources.used_for: unit-S3 scalar/vector/tensor Laplace, divergence, trace and normalization conventions including exceptional low-mode ranges

primary_sources.not_used_for: the repository-local cutoff counts or any gravitational constraint algebra

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: eigenvalue lambda_n=n(n+2) and degeneracy (n+1)^2 are imported as source-pinned spectral data; this runner does not prove scalar-basis completeness
theorem_guards.hypotheses: Delta_rough=-D^2, n is an integer with n>=0, and scalar modes use the pinned Lindblom-Taylor-Zhang convention
theorem_guards.theorem: unit-round-S3 scalar harmonic spectrum and degeneracy

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: rough eigenvalue lambda_n-1, Hodge eigenvalue lambda_n+1, and combined degeneracy 2n(n+2) are imported; no explicit vector basis or chirality-resolved ledger is constructed
theorem_guards.hypotheses: D^a V_a=0, n is an integer with n>=1, both chiral families are combined, and the pinned source convention is used
theorem_guards.theorem: unit-round-S3 transverse-vector spectrum and combined degeneracy

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: rough eigenvalue lambda_n-2 and combined degeneracy 2(n-1)(n+3) are imported; the polynomial is never applied below n=2 and no TT completeness proof is produced
theorem_guards.hypotheses: D^aT_ab=0=T^a_a, n is an integer with n>=2, both TT families are combined, and the pinned Lindblom/Higuchi conventions including the cited erratum are used
theorem_guards.theorem: unit-round-S3 transverse-traceless rank-two spectrum and combined degeneracy

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: the gradient, tracefree-Hessian and transverse-symmetrized-gradient norms and rough shifts recorded below are source-pinned analytic identities, not results proved by symbolic self-comparison

theorem_guards.theorem: Bochner/commutator identities for scalar- and vector-derived harmonics on unit S3
